Ver. 1.4 「For Whom the Verses Mourn」 Patch Notes

Neverness to Everness>Intel>News

2026.09.29

Hey Appraiser,

NTE will undergo maintenance on September 30, 06:00 – 11:00 (UTC+8). Once it's done, the all-new Version 1.4 "For Whom the Verses Mourn" goes live. "Pink Paws Heist" will be temporarily unavailable starting September 30, 05:30 (UTC+8) and will reopen once maintenance wraps up.
Login will be unavailable during this period, so please plan accordingly. Since this is a large update, please keep your data plan in mind when choosing between Wi-Fi and mobile data. We apologize for any inconvenience.
※ The current Linko Limited Board "Surfing All Channels!" ends on September 30, 2026, 05:59 (UTC+8). Be sure to head to the Sync Perks event page and redeem the board's skin & outfit rewards before then.


[Maintenance & Compensation]
● Maintenance Window: September 30, 2026, 06:00 – 11:00 (UTC+8)
● Maintenance Compensation: Annulith x300
● Eligibility: Appraisers who created a character before September 30, 2026, 06:00 (UTC+8)
● Distribution: Sent via in-game mail after maintenance. Be sure to claim the items before they expire.
※ Maintenance may end earlier or later than scheduled depending on actual progress. Please keep an eye on our official announcements for updates.

● Bug Fix Compensation: Annulith x300
● Eligibility: Appraisers who created a character before September 30, 2026, 06:00 (UTC+8)
● Distribution: Sent via in-game mail after maintenance. Be sure to claim the items before they expire.

[How to Update]
PC: Close the game, reopen the launcher, and click Update.
Android: Launch the game and follow the in-game update prompt.
iOS: Download or update from the App Store.
Mac: Download or update from the App Store.
PlayStation®: Open the system menu, select NTE, press the OPTIONS button on your controller, then select Check for Update.
Steam: Close the game, exit and restart the Steam client, go to your Library, find NTE, and click Update to start the download.
Epic: Close the game, reopen the game launcher, and click Update.

[Pukaland Fest Special Gift Pack]
After the version update on September 30, 2026 (UTC+8), claim Solid Dice x10 and the "Like Clockwork" avatar frame from your mail.
After the second update on October 21, 2026 (UTC+8), claim Akane's "House Special" outfit and Fons x2,000,000 from your mail.
Eligibility: Appraisers who have created a character and unlocked the Mail feature before Version 1.4 ends.

2. New Story
● New Main Story Episode: "The Witch"
A mysterious letter. A sinister ritual. A town shrouded in secrets...
Fear clouds eyes that should see clearly, and no fire can burn away the shadow of the curse.
In the lull between endless trials, the bewildered townsfolk whisper:
"Witch, witch, where are you?"

3. New Locations
● New Location: Pukaland
Where joy gathers, anything can happen.
Welcome to Pukaland! Make the most of everything it has to offer. Adventures, chance encounters, even the occasional unbelievable fairy tale: embrace them all and write your own story!
Appraisers can exchange Puka Stars for the "Pukaland Gold Pass" at the Puka Exchange Shop. Pass holders receive a permanent 90% discount on all Pukaland attractions.

A town at the foot of the mountain, once a quiet place where people lived and worked in peace.

[Optimizations & Bug Fixes]
◆ Add a new cosmetic system: Accessories
◆ Add multiplayer to "Volley Star"
◆ Add a follow-cam mode to "Photo Mode - Drone Mode"
◆ Add new collectible types to "Going, Going, Gone!", plus a new Auction Assistant: Blackbird
◆ Add "Sweetdream Charity Drive" to City Tycoon: donate specific items to directly boost your Fons progress
◆ Increase Fons accumulation speed in the original City Tycoon Program
◆ Increase Hunter Supplies level cap to Lvl 80 and boost rewards beyond Lvl 50
◆ Add a "Bulk Gift" button to the Bond interface, so you can quickly redeem or purchase gifts and max out Bond Levels
◆ Add "First Meeting Replay" to the Character interface: linger for a bit to play the character's unlock animation (enable it under Settings › Control › First Meeting Replay)
◆ Add friend recommendations to the Friends interface
◆ Move "Fighting with a Dragon" to Spinoffs
◆ Allow placing Figurines anywhere on your Property, or displaying them in a Figurine Cabinet.
◆ Add Bond quests for Blackbird
◆ Add Bond interactions for Blackbird: reach the required Bond Level to unlock her passenger seat ride-along.
◆ Add a combat tutorial for Blackbird
◆ Improve controller support for Linko's Life Skill
◆ Fix an issue where Lacrimosa's Awakening Effect "Morning Spell" did not take effect when a Redirect Skill was used to cast Linko's "Ultimate: Oversync"
◆ Fix an issue where switching to Zankou after Linko cast "Ultimate: Oversync" displayed Zankou's Ultimate cooldown incorrectly when "Ultimate: Inferno Flamenco" had full Ultimate Energy but was still on cooldown
◆ Fix an issue where Linko's "Basic Attack: Spectral Rush" could sometimes lose its target
◆ Fix incorrect damage calculation when Linko triggers a Synced Strike
◆ Fix an issue where Linko could sometimes clip through models during the Hug interaction
◆ Fix missing sound effects for Iroi's jump and landing roll
◆ Fix an issue where some character outfits were missing their Awakening Lvl 6 visual effects
◆ Fix an issue where the achievement "Pinky Promise" could not be completed
◆ Fix crashes that could occur in certain situations.
◆ Improve localization for several languages.
◆ Fix other known issues.

Neverness to Everness (NTE) is a supernatural open-world RPG developed by Hotta Studio. The story begins in the city of Hethereau, where you play as the first "unlicensed" Anomaly Hunter. You will join the antique shop Eibon, which relies on taking on Anomaly commissions from the public to stay afloat. Alongside your diverse and extraordinary partners, you'll explore various urban mysteries, experiencing an array of adventures filled with laughter and tears, and crafting your unique urban saga.
